script:
onRoleReachedMoon = function() 
    game.pauseLogic()
	if global.getBool("lvl52_b1") then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
		repeat
			sound.play("51-1");
		    if dialog.show("Level52-1", faceWunai) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level52-2", faceZhoumei) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level52-3", faceRenzhen) ==1 then break end
			sound.play("50-2");
			if dialog.show("Level52-4", facePutong) ==1 then break end
		    if dialog.show("Level52-5", facePutong) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level52-6", faceBujie) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level52-7", facePutong) ==1 then break end
			sound.play("60-1");
			if dialog.show("Level52-8", faceBujie) ==1 then break end
			global.setBool("lvl52_b1")
		until true
		dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
    game.success()
end
